name: .257 Cal-100gr Lever Hammer
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "We designed this Stone Hammer™ style bullet specifically for the 25-35 Winchester lever action tube magazine rifle. With the large 3mm hollow point and extra meat on the meplat this bullet will work well in the tube magazine."
